panels.title: Agent run latency
panels.description: Requires the documented telemetry contract. No data is not evidence of health. Latency percentiles reflect retained spans.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
union AppRequests, AppDependencies
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where tostring(Properties["gen_ai.operation.name"]) == "invoke_agent"
| extend Agent = tostring(Properties["gen_ai.agent.name"])
| summarize P50_ms = percentile(DurationMs, 50),
    P95_ms = percentile(DurationMs, 95),
    P99_ms = percentile(DurationMs, 99)
    by bin(TimeGenerated, $__interval), Agent
| order by TimeGenerated asc

panels.title: Agent runs and failures
panels.description: Requires the documented telemetry contract. No data is not evidence of health. Latency percentiles reflect retained spans.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
union AppRequests, AppDependencies
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where tostring(Properties["gen_ai.operation.name"]) == "invoke_agent"
| extend Agent = tostring(Properties["gen_ai.agent.name"])
| summarize ObservedRuns = sum(ItemCount),
    FailedRuns = sumif(ItemCount, Success == false)
    by bin(TimeGenerated, $__interval), Agent
| order by TimeGenerated asc

panels.title: Tool performance
panels.description: Requires the documented telemetry contract. No data is not evidence of health. Latency percentiles reflect retained spans.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
union AppRequests, AppDependencies
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where tostring(Properties["gen_ai.operation.name"]) == "execute_tool"
| extend Tool = tostring(Properties["gen_ai.tool.name"])
| summarize ObservedCalls = sum(ItemCount),
    FailedCalls = sumif(ItemCount, Success == false),
    P95_ms = percentile(DurationMs, 95) by Tool
| order by P95_ms desc

panels.title: Model token usage and missing usage spans
panels.description: Requires the documented telemetry contract. No data is not evidence of health. Latency percentiles reflect retained spans.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
union AppRequests, AppDependencies
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where tostring(Properties["gen_ai.operation.name"]) in ("chat", "text_completion")
| extend Model = tostring(Properties["gen_ai.response.model"]),
    InputTokens = tolong(Properties["gen_ai.usage.input_tokens"]),
    OutputTokens = tolong(Properties["gen_ai.usage.output_tokens"])
| summarize InputTokens = sum(InputTokens * ItemCount),
    OutputTokens = sum(OutputTokens * ItemCount),
    MissingUsageSpans = countif(isnull(InputTokens) or isnull(OutputTokens))
    by bin(TimeGenerated, $__interval), Model
| order by TimeGenerated asc

panels.title: Failed operations - trace IDs
panels.description: Requires the documented telemetry contract. No data is not evidence of health. Latency percentiles reflect retained spans.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
union AppRequests, AppDependencies
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where Success == false
| where isnotempty(tostring(Properties["gen_ai.operation.name"]))
| project TimeGenerated, OperationId, Name, ResultCode, DurationMs,
    Agent = tostring(Properties["gen_ai.agent.name"]),
    Operation = tostring(Properties["gen_ai.operation.name"])
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 100

panels.title: Instrumentation coverage
panels.description: Requires the documented telemetry contract. No data is not evidence of health. Latency percentiles reflect retained spans.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
union AppRequests, AppDependencies
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| extend Operation = tostring(Properties["gen_ai.operation.name"]),
    Agent = tostring(Properties["gen_ai.agent.name"])
| summarize ObservedSpans = sum(ItemCount),
    GenAISpans = sumif(ItemCount, isnotempty(Operation)),
    AgentRuns = sumif(ItemCount, Operation == "invoke_agent"),
    UnnamedAgentRuns = sumif(ItemCount, Operation == "invoke_agent" and isempty(Agent))
    by bin(TimeGenerated, $__interval)
| order by TimeGenerated asc

panels.title: Evaluation results (optional custom events)
panels.description: Requires the documented telemetry contract. No data is not evidence of health. Latency percentiles reflect retained spans.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
AppEvents
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where Name == "obs.evaluation"
| extend Evaluator = tostring(Properties["obs.evaluator.name"]),
    Score = todouble(Properties["obs.evaluation.score"]),
    Passed = tobool(Properties["obs.evaluation.passed"])
| summarize EvaluatedSamples = count(), AverageScore = avg(Score),
    FailedSamples = countif(Passed == false),
    InvalidSamples = countif(isnull(Score) or isnull(Passed)) by Evaluator
| order by Evaluator asc
